alternativeSelection.assessment: One provisional option responds to language processing and language use through psycholinguistics, cognitive science and research methods. Formal logic and stylistics cannot support a separate structural linguistics option without sustained syntax, phonology and morphology. General psychology and neuroscience do not provide clinical language assessment, treatment or specialist language neuroimaging.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both address language processing and experimental psycholinguistics. Groningen devotes a separate course to a psycholinguistics project.
Both examine applications of AI alongside ethics and effects on people and society. Groningen also studies language, multimodality and AI literacy.
Both support empirical research using statistical analysis. UCR applies multivariable models and experimental methods to behavioural research.

notes.text: UCR brings together psycholinguistics, cognition, behavioural research and text analysis. Groningen also has a sequence in phonology, syntax, semantics and language change, as well as clinical assessment, neuroimaging and specialist graduation seminars.

audience.programmeDescription: Linguistics at the University of Groningen studies how people learn and use language, how languages are structured, and what happens when language is affected by a disorder.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers related study in psycholinguistics and cognitive science. Groningen provides a dedicated sequence in language structure, clinical linguistics and research on language and the brain.
